theme_strategy.description: Professional ERP Light-first design with neutral slate/zinc foundations, crisp 1px borders, subtle surface elevations, and dynamic custom accent branding that controls interactive highlights and primary CTAs.

currency_and_numbers.locale_rules: Format Indonesian Rupiah with prefix 'Rp ' and thousands separator '.', e.g. 'Rp 148.500.000'. Numbers right-aligned in all tables and data ledgers.

entry_surfaces./: ERP Light layout with persistent left navigation sidebar, sticky top utility header with search and theme/accent toolbar, and high-density KPI & data workspace.
entry_surfaces./login: Branded dual-panel business auth: company positioning and audit highlights on left, clean white authentication card with locale switcher on right.

sidebar.style: bg-sidebar border-r border-border text-sidebar-foreground h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col justify-between py-4 px-3 select-none
sidebar.logo_block: AuditPro AI (with ERP Business Shield mark and active PT / Entity badge)
sidebar.footer_block: Active Organization switcher (e.g. 'PT Nusantara Solusi Digital'), current user status, and quick theme customizer trigger.

header.style: sticky top-0 z-30 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border px-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-4
elements: Global search bar with shortcut badge (Ctrl + K) for instant invoice/ledger/document search
Quick fiscal period filter (e.g. 'Bulan Ini: Agustus 2026', 'Q3 2026', 'Tahun 2026')
Live AI Sync & OCR status indicator (Pulsing emerald dot: 'Sistem Sinkron')
Theme switcher popover (Light / Dark / Custom Accent Picker)
Notification bell with pending approval count badge

container_grid.padding: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto

dashboard_overview.chart_section: Dual-axis Revenue vs Expenses AreaChart (Recharts) with clean gradient fills, custom tooltip showing formatted IDR values, and period toggles (Bulanan, Kuartalan, Tahunan).
dashboard_overview.recent_invoices_ledger: Clean bordered table with column alignment: No. Invoice (mono), Klien/PT, Tanggal, Nominal (mono right-aligned), Status Badge, Aksi (Aksi Cepat).
dashboard_overview.embedded_ai_briefing: Executive AI summary card highlighting anomalies, tax optimization recommendations, and payment reminders.

dokumen_ocr_vault.style: Structured tabular vault with OCR Confidence bar (0-100%), Document Type chip (Kwitansi, Faktur Pajak, PO, Invoice Vendor), Validation status, and quick validation drawer.

invoice_studio.style: Side-by-side template editor with live paper preview (A4 format with Indonesian tax compliance notes, e-meterai zone, bank transfer details) + Export toolbar (PDF, Excel, e-Faktur XML draft).

laporan_dan_pajak.style: Financial Statement matrix (Laba Rugi, Neraca Ringkas, Rekonsiliasi PPN & PPh 23) with 1-click official export and audit logs.

ai_assistant_workspace.style: Split chat view: Left conversation history and financial query templates (e.g., 'Analisis Margin Produk Q2', 'Cek Anomali Pengeluaran > Rp 10 Juta', 'Simulasi Pembayaran PPN'), Right streaming chat thread with structured financial cards.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out, transition-shadow duration-150 ease-in-out

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast on light/dark surfaces)
accessibility.table_navigation: Sticky headers, aria-sort on sortable columns, full keyboard focus rings with custom accent offset (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2)
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All actionable controls and key financial metrics MUST feature kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g. data-testid='kpi-omzet-value', data-testid='theme-toggle-button', data-testid='accent-color-picker', data-testid='btn-export-pdf')

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update frontend/src/index.css with @import statements for '@fontsource-variable/manrope', '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans', and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'. Setup clean light-mode :root variables as primary default, .dark variables, and link primary accents to var(--brand-accent, #0284C7).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Implement ThemeProvider context in frontend/src/lib/theme-provider.tsx supporting theme ('light' | 'dark') and brandAccent (hex string). Persist in localStorage under key 'auditpro_theme_config' and apply CSS variable --brand-accent to document.documentElement.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build ThemeSwitcher component in the top header with Light / Dark toggle and Accent Color swatch picker + custom hex input.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Overhaul Layout shell (Sidebar + Header + Breadcrumb) into modern white/light-slate ERP aesthetic with crisp borders, collapsible navigation, and responsive mobile sheet drawer.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Refactor all pages (Overview, Dokumen OCR, Transaksi Ledger, Invoice Studio, Laporan, Pajak, AI Assistant, Customer, Piutang) into high-clarity ERP tables and card widgets with Rupiah formatting (Rp X.XXX.XXX) and status badges without breaking existing state/logic.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Ensure all inputs and buttons use customized shadcn components and verify responsive breakpoints across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px+).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Never use generic centering for ERP data grids. Use strict left alignment for descriptions and right alignment for monetary values. Avoid heavy dark gradients in light mode; use crisp 1px borders (#E2E8F0) and subtle elevation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.locale: Indonesian B2B ERP format: Currency formatted as 'Rp 1.482.350.000', dates formatted as '18 Agu 2026' or 'DD/MM/YYYY'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_readiness: All buttons, inputs, tabs, and metric items MUST have data-testid attributes.
